dialogue.content: 今日はよろしくお願いします。お願いがあるのですが、希死念慮があるクライアントを演じて頂きたいのですが。お願いできますでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today. I have a request. I was hoping you could role-play as a client with suicidal ideation. Would that be possible?

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、よろしくお願いいたします。上記、承知いたしました。
dialogue.English: The pleasure is mine. I understand the request.

dialogue.content: はい、苦手な分野の為、助かります
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. This is an area where I'm not as experienced, so this is very helpful.

dialogue.content: お時間になりましたら始めさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: We'll begin when it's time.

dialogue.content: 了解です
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: 差し支えなければ年齢と性別をおしえていただけますか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 高２ 女子
dialogue.English: I'm a second-year high school student, female.

dialogue.content: 教えてくださりありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 死にたいです
dialogue.English: I want to die.

dialogue.content: そんなふうに思われてるんですね・・どんなことでもお話聴きますので、お話くださいね。
dialogue.English: I see you're feeling that way... I'm here to listen to anything you want to talk about, so please feel free to share.

dialogue.content: 生きていたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to be alive.

dialogue.content: 生きていたくないって思うほど辛いことがあったんですね・・
dialogue.English: Something must have happened that is so painful it makes you feel like you don't want to live anymore...

dialogue.content: どんなことがあったのでしょうか
dialogue.English: What kinds of things have been happening?

dialogue.content: 何となく生きているのが辛いです
dialogue.English: Just living feels painful somehow.

dialogue.content: 辛いって思うのはいつ頃からなんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Since about when have you been feeling this way?

dialogue.content: 去年ぐらいからだと思います
dialogue.English: I think it started around last year.

dialogue.content: そんなに前から・・辛かったんですね・・去年というと、高2の頃でしょうか？その時に何かあったのか思い当たることってありますか？
dialogue.English: For that long... You must have been in a lot of pain. When you say last year, was that during your second year of high school? Can you think of anything that might have happened around that time?

dialogue.content: あまり思いた当たることがなくて
dialogue.English: I can't really think of anything specific.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。何となく漠然としたもやもやするような辛い感じなんですね・・学校の様子はどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see. So it's more of a vague, unsettling kind of pain... How are things at school?

dialogue.content: 学校のこと考えると頭が痛くなります
dialogue.English: Thinking about school gives me a headache.

dialogue.content: あんまり楽しくないです
dialogue.English: It's not very fun.

dialogue.content: そっかあ・・学校が楽しくなくて辛い感じなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see... School isn't enjoyable, and that makes it painful.

dialogue.content: 仲良しのお友達とかは？
dialogue.English: What about close friends?

dialogue.content: あんまりいないです
dialogue.English: I don't really have any.

dialogue.content: あまりというと、何人かはいるっていうことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you say 'not really,' does that mean you have a few?

dialogue.content: うーん、学校に行きたくないのでほとんど話さないです
dialogue.English: Well, I don't want to go to school, so I barely talk to anyone.

dialogue.content: そっかあ話す友達がいないとさびしいですよね・・
dialogue.English: I see. It must be lonely not having friends to talk to...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつも一人で行動してるような感じですか？
dialogue.English: Do you usually do things by yourself?

dialogue.content: 基本的に、いつも一人です
dialogue.English: Basically, I'm always alone.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それでは学校も行きたくなくなってしまうのは、無理もないことだと思います。それは高2の時からでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, it's completely understandable that you wouldn't want to go to school. Has it been like that since your second year?

dialogue.content: いま高２なので、高1ぐらいからです
dialogue.English: I'm a second-year now, so it started around my first year.

dialogue.content: あ・ごめんなさいね。高１の打ち間違いしてました。
dialogue.English: Oh, I'm sorry. I mistyped; I meant to say first year.

dialogue.content: そんな状況の中、学校はお休みしないで毎日行ってたんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: In that situation, were you still going to school every day without taking any days off?

dialogue.content: 時々休んでました。でも親がうるさいから仕方なく行ってました。
dialogue.English: I took days off sometimes. But my parents kept nagging me about it, so I went because I had no choice.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。とても辛いのに、しんどかったですね・・
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been so hard, going when you were in so much pain...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 本当は学校なんて行きたくない・・って思いながらも辛くて苦しくても仕方なく耐えてきたんですね。
dialogue.English: So even though you really didn't want to go to school, you've been enduring the pain and suffering because you felt you had no choice.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 辛くて死んでしまいたいとまで思ってしまう気持ちを、ここで話してくれて本当に良かったと思います。
dialogue.English: I'm truly glad you were able to talk here about feeling so distressed that you want to die.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 辛い気持ちを言葉にするのって勇気がいることだと、思うんです。
dialogue.English: I think it takes a lot of courage to put such painful feelings into words.

dialogue.content: あなたの力になりたいので、自分の気持ちをまずは吐き出してみてくださいね。
dialogue.English: I want to help you, so please try to start by letting out your feelings.

dialogue.content: ずっと一人で抱えたままだと、よけいに辛くなってしまうから・・
dialogue.English: Because if you keep holding it all in by yourself, it will only become more painful...

dialogue.content: はい、あまり話す人もいないので話せてよかったです
dialogue.English: Yes, I don't really have anyone to talk to, so I'm glad I could talk about it.

dialogue.content: そして少しでも辛い気持ちが和らぐように、力になりたいです。
dialogue.English: And I want to help ease your painful feelings, even just a little.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: どんなことでも話してくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please feel free to talk about anything at all.

dialogue.content: でもどんな風に話したらいいかわからない
dialogue.English: But I don't know how to talk about it.

dialogue.content: そういう自分も嫌になります
dialogue.English: I hate myself for being like that.

dialogue.content: うん、うん自分の気持ちって言葉にするのは難しいから、まずはとても困っていることとか、から話してもらえますか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I understand. It's difficult to put your feelings into words. Could we start with something that's really troubling you?

dialogue.content: 親がうるさいことが嫌です
dialogue.English: I don't like my parents nagging me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。うるさいのはお母さん？お父さん？
dialogue.English: I see. Is it your mother or your father who nags you?

dialogue.content: どっちもですけど、うるさいのはお母さんかなお父さんは、なんかすごくイヤです
dialogue.English: Both of them, but I guess my mom is the one who nags more. As for my dad... I just really can't stand him.

dialogue.content: そっか・・お母さんがあなたにいろいろと干渉する感じなんですね。例えば、どんなことをうるさく言われたりするんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... So your mother tends to meddle in your affairs a lot. For example, what kinds of things does she nag you about?

dialogue.content: とにかく学校行けとか、他の子はえらいとか比べてくる感じです
dialogue.English: She just tells me to go to school, and she compares me to other kids, saying how great they are.

dialogue.content: それでは、とても辛くなってしまいますね。
dialogue.English: That must make things very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までのあなたのお話を伺って、学校でも気が置けるお友達もいなくて、家でも心が休まらない状態で・・生きていたくなるような辛いお気持ちが伝わってきました。
dialogue.English: Listening to what you've shared so far, I can sense the painful feelings that make you not want to live... not having friends at school you can relax with, and not being able to find peace at home either.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そして、あなたはきっと自分に気持ちを人に伝えるのに苦手意識があるような感じがしましたが、どう思われますか？
dialogue.English: Also, I get the sense that you may find it difficult to express your feelings to others. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: そうです、そのとおりです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly right.

dialogue.content: 自分に→自分のです
dialogue.English: Correction: I meant 'your own' feelings.

dialogue.content: きっと思っていることをもう少し気軽にお友達にも伝えることができたら、きっと気が合うお友達もできるのでは？と思うのですが、いかがでしょうか
dialogue.English: If you could share what you're thinking a little more casually with others, I believe you might be able to find friends you get along with. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: そうなれればいいと思うのですが、考えるだけで辛くなります
dialogue.English: I think it would be nice if I could, but just thinking about it is painful.

dialogue.content: もし、お時間があればたまにでもいいので、こちらにお話しにきて自分の気持ちを伝えることをしてみませんか？あなたには、それがとても大事だと思うのです。
dialogue.English: If you have time, even just occasionally, would you like to come here to talk and practice expressing your feelings? I think that's something very important for you.

dialogue.content: はい、そうしたいです。話すは得意でないので、こういうところは助かります
dialogue.English: Yes, I'd like that. I'm not good at talking, so a place like this is helpful.

dialogue.content: 今まで自分の気持ちを伝える機会がなかっただけで、経験値が圧倒的に足りないだけなんだ、と私は思います。
dialogue.English: I believe it's just that you haven't had many opportunities to express your feelings before, so you simply lack the experience.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ぜひこちらでお話して、経験値を高めていきましょうね。
dialogue.English: Let's definitely talk here and build up that experience, okay?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: きっと、あなたと気が合うお友達もできると思いますよ。
dialogue.English: I'm sure you'll be able to make friends you click with.

dialogue.content: 今日は勇気を出してこちらに相談にきてくださり、本当に嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: I'm truly glad that you found the courage to come and talk with me today.

dialogue.content: はい、聞いてくれてありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for listening.

dialogue.content: ぜひ何度でも、こちらに辛い気持ちもですが、気軽にその日の出来事で感じたことでもなんでもいいので、時々いらしてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Please feel free to come back anytime, not just with painful feelings, but with anything at all, like things you felt during the day. Please stop by occasionally.

dialogue.content: しっかりお話を聴きますね。
dialogue.English: I'll be here to listen carefully.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Okay, thank you.

dialogue.content: 気持ちでも感じたことでも、言葉にするのってとても大事だと思うので、また今日の続きでもなんでもいいので、お待ちしていますね。
dialogue.English: I think it's very important to put your thoughts and feelings into words, so whether you want to continue our conversation from today or talk about something new, I'll be waiting for you.

dialogue.content: 話を聞いてくれてありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you for listening to me.

dialogue.content: はい、こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you as well.

dialogue.content: また、次回学校のことやお家のことなど、お話を聴かせてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Next time, please tell me more about school or things at home.

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: あなたが楽しい学校生活を送れるように、応援してしますね。
dialogue.English: I'll be cheering for you so that you can have an enjoyable school life.

dialogue.content: 失礼しました。応援していますね。
dialogue.English: My apologies for the typo. I'm cheering for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 今日は終了にさせていただきますね。
dialogue.English: We'll end our session for today.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you, too.

dialogue.content: （今日は遅い時間までありがとうございました。中高生の相談と希死傾向のあるクライアントが苦手なのでとても勉強になるケース助かりました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time so late today. I'm not as experienced with counseling middle/high school students and clients with suicidal tendencies, so this was a very helpful and educational case.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、勉強になりました。ありがとうございます。言葉の少ない高校生とのロープレお疲れさまでした。
dialogue.English: (It was a learning experience for me as well. Thank you. You did a great job role-playing with a high school student of few words.)

dialogue.content: （終了ボタン押させて頂きますね）
dialogue.English: (I'll press the end button now.)
